info.name: manifest-version-pin-tests
info.description:
Stripped-down runnable collection for one requirement: when a manifest is supplied to ValueSet/$expand, the expansion SHALL use the value set definition version the manifest binds, not the server's latest.

Why it exists: Quality Program 6.6 Expand With Manifest asserts a manifest-pinned version, but the value set it uses (2.16.840.1.113883.3.526.3.1010) has the same pinned and latest version, so it passes whether or not the manifest is honoured. This collection makes the pin/latest distinction explicit and refuses to report a meaningless pass.

Shape: read the manifest and extract the pin at runtime (no hard-coded versions) -> baseline expand with no manifest to record latest -> expand with the manifest in both instance and canonical form -> control expand with an explicit valueSetVersion.

Run:
  newman run manifest-pin.json -e workspace.postman_globals.json

Defaults to the case reported against VSAC 2026-09: value set 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1095.89 with manifest ecqm-update-2026-05-14, which pins 20240117 while the latest published version is 20260905. Override VS_OID / VS_CANONICAL / MANIFEST_ID / MANIFEST_CANONICAL to retarget.

Expected today: Manifest 1, 2 and 5 pass; Manifest 3 and 4 fail on the 'serves the manifest-pinned version' assertion.

item.name: Manifest 1 GET manifest Library (extract the value set pin)

exec: // Requirement - the manifest determines the value set version to expand:
// CRMI 2.0.0: "search for a version-specific reference to that URL, and return the
// version-specific reference for resolution ... predictably bound to the specific version of
// the value set required for the release." Falling back to latest is the no-manifest path.
// pm.variables.get honours the full precedence chain (data > environment > collection),
// so a --env-var override of the target value set reaches the script and not just the URL.
pm.test('Manifest pins a definition version for the target value set', function () {
'No version pin for ' + VS + ' in manifest ' + (body.url || '') +
'. Checked relatedArtifact.depends-on versioned canonicals and contained Parameters ' +
'Without a pin the rest of these requests cannot test anything - point VS_CANONICAL / ' +
'VS_OID at a value set this manifest pins, or use a manifest that pins it.'
// Baseline: no manifest, so the server is entitled to serve its latest version.
// Recorded only so the manifest tests below can prove the manifest changed the outcome.
pm.expect(body.version, 'ValueSet.version missing - cannot establish a baseline')

pm.test('$expand with manifest did not fall back to latest (instance form)', function () {

// Informational only. A server can echo the manifest parameter while ignoring the version it

item.name: Manifest 5 Control explicit valueSetVersion serves the pinned version

exec: // Control. Asks for the pinned version explicitly via valueSetVersion, which CRMI precedence
// rule 1 treats as an override supplied directly to the operation.
// Purpose is to separate two failures that look alike:
//   this passes + manifest tests fail -> server CAN serve the pinned version but does not
//   this fails  + manifest tests fail -> the pinned version is not retained at all
pm.test('Control $expand with explicit valueSetVersion returns 200', function () {
pm.test('Control: explicit valueSetVersion serves the pinned version', function () {
// Parse a response body without throwing. Returns {} for empty/non-JSON bodies so that
// "server returned nothing useful" surfaces as a failed assertion, not a script TypeError.
// Find the version a manifest (CRMIManifestLibrary / quality-program-cqfm Library) binds for a
// value set canonical. Two mechanisms are supported, because manifests in the wild use either:
//      This is the shape VSAC's ecqm-update-* manifests use (711 such entries in
//      ecqm-update-2022-05-05, and no contained Parameters at all). CRMI describes resolution
//      for exactly this shape under "Canonical Resolution With a Manifest".
//   2. A manifest-parameters entry in a contained Parameters resource: default-valueset-version
//      (CRMI 2.0.0) or canonicalVersion (the CRMI STU1 spelling, which is what our own
// Precedence follows CRMI: force- beats an explicit reference version, which beats default-.
// Returns { version, source, candidates } - version is null when the manifest pins nothing.
if (v) { candidates.push({ version: v, source: 'manifest parameter:' + p.name }); }
var winner = candidates.length ? candidates[0] : { version: null, source: null };
return { version: winner.version, source: winner.source, candidates: candidates };
